title: deterministic evidence (v1)
description: Outcome vocabulary for the deterministic CI lane. Deterministic tests are reproducible, require no privileged host capabilities (no /dev/kvm, no /dev/net/tun, no cgroup-v2 mutation), and are NOT gated by a host preflight. Use this schema for unit tests, property tests, API contract tests, scheduler pure logic, and any result that does not need a real KVM/Firecracker host.

class.description: Constant discriminator that identifies the lane. Every evidence artifact in the deterministic lane MUST set this to 'deterministic' so downstream tooling can branch on lane without parsing the file name.

items.description: Per-test outcomes. Each item is a flat record (name, pass, duration_ms, log_path) with no host or substrate metadata; deterministic tests are reproducible across hosts so per-host fields would only confuse the result.

name.description: Stable identifier for the test (e.g. 'microvm-types::roundtrip', 'microvm-lifecycle::state_machine::created_to_configured'). Used by tooling to attribute failures and to construct the summary.

pass.description: True iff the test ran to completion and matched its expected outcome. False indicates a failed assertion, a panic, or a setup error. A failing deterministic test blocks the lane; there is no 'blocked' state in the deterministic lane.

duration_ms.description: Wall-clock duration of the test in milliseconds. Reported as a non-negative integer; the validator rejects negative durations.

log_path.description: Repository-relative path to the test log (e.g. 'target/nextest/default/test-results.xml' or a per-test log file under runtime/logs/<test-name>.log). MUST NOT be an absolute path and MUST NOT point outside the repository.

summary.description: Aggregate counts. Must satisfy: total == items.length; pass == items where pass==true; fail == items where pass==false. Validators do NOT enforce the arithmetic (json-schema cannot count), but reviewers MUST reject artifacts where the math does not reconcile.

total.description: Total number of test items recorded. Must equal items.length.
